scripts.typecheck: npm run build && node examples/sqlite/generate.mjs && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p examples/sqlite --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.prepack:packages: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('.release', { recursive: true, force: true }); mkdirSync('.release')"
scripts.pack:packages: npm pack --workspace packages/adapters/pg --workspace packages/adapters/sqlite --workspace packages/db --workspace packages/kysely --workspace packages/models --ignore-scripts --pack-destination .release
